name: Pauter 993-230-580-1270F 4340 steel connecting rod (aftermarket, inventory only)

material.process: shot-peened; forming route (forging or billet) not declared for this product

limitations: Inventory record only. No geometry, drawing, printing or manufacturing file is produced: a connecting rod is a highly loaded internal engine component, presumed critical in SAFETY.md, and its reproduction or modification requires documented professional engineering review and an approved validation plan.

The five size parameters are the manufacturer's nominal values. Pauter publishes them as abbreviations (C-C, BE DIA, BE W, SE DIA, SE W); the TZR listing of the same part number gives their German definitions. No tolerance is published except a big-end bore accuracy of +/- 0.003 mm declared on the TZR listing.

Process: neither the Pauter product page nor the TZR listing states whether this rod is forged or machined from billet. The Pauter product-family statement that most rods use 4340 steel forgings, with 4340 billet for special applications (MEZGER-P010), does not authenticate the route of this part. Shot peening and material crack testing are declared on the TZR listing only. No heat treatment, hardness or material certificate is published.

Mass: 535 g is the declared overall mass. TZR declares a maximum spread of 1 g within a set, which is not a tolerance on the nominal value, so tolerance_g stays null. Pauter also declares a 373 g big-end mass (MEZGER-P008), for which this schema has no field.

Aftermarket product with a manufacturer-listed 993 and 993 Turbo application. It does not identify the original Porsche rod, its metallurgy or its operating envelope; no rpm or power limit is published.
Rod bolts are ARP 2000 per the TZR listing; their size and tightening torque are not sourced (MEZGER-P014), so no fastening relation is recorded.
